architecture_summary.principle: Read-only photo evidence engine; no delete, move, rename or EXIF write-back
layers: L1: normalized full RGBA8 pixel equality under a pinned decoder/algorithm version
L2: pHash/dHash visual candidates only, never a deletion authorization
architecture_summary.scope: Every scan/hash/visual job requires an explicit manifest; no automatic full-library scan; read budgets accumulate across resume
architecture_summary.persistence: Local SQLite WAL, per-file transactions, isolated worker process groups, resumable jobs

testing.fixtures: Synthetic images and temporary directories only; tests never read the real NAS
testing.known_inconsistency: pyproject.toml declares Python >=3.11 while numpy/scipy visual pins require >=3.12

anonymous_access.note: 404 means not published, not 401/403 permission denial. See docs/ai-portal/ACCESS_REPORT.md for full evidence.

known_limitations: github.com/robots.txt has an AI user-agent group (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User) containing Disallow: /*/tree/, /*/raw/ and /*/blame/. Web-fetch tools that honor robots.txt may refuse those github.com paths even though the server returns HTTP 200.
Changing repository visibility, permissions or branch protection cannot fix a client-side robots policy or a specific web tool's own fetch restrictions.
Anonymous GitHub API is limited to 60 requests/hour; heavy use may yield HTTP 403 as rate limiting, not an authorization failure.
Runtime authoritative state (reports/agent-coordination/STATE.json, PROJECT_STATUS.md, TASK_BOARD.md) is intentionally not in Git and cannot be read through any anonymous link.
